install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The repo ships only a Dockerfile.production meant for Ghost's own CI/multi-stage release build (not a plain docker compose recipe), so used the project's official prebuilt image (ghost:5-alpine) directly instead. Two fixes needed: (1) the image's default config bound to an address this sandbox's Docker network couldn't serve on, crash-looping with an 'InternalServerError (Code: -97)' (EADDRNOTAVAIL) - fixed via server__host=0.0.0.0 and server__port=2368 env vars (the image's own supported config-override mechanism). (2) Ghost defaults to requiring a MySQL connection (ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3306 with none provided) - switched to Ghost's built-in SQLite support (database__client=sqlite3 + a file path under the content volume) instead of adding a separate MySQL service, since SQLite is a fully supported first-class Ghost backend and keeps this a single-container recipe. Booted cleanly with the default seeded blog (a real 'Coming soon' demo post), 1 screen genuinely discovered/rendered for this fresh install.
